source.publisher: Central Elections Committee for the 26th Knesset (ועדת הבחירות המרכזית לכנסת)
source.title: רשימות המועמדים לכנסת ה-26 — as approved by the CEC plenum on 27.9.2026
source.notes: Lists, ranks, titles, ballot letters and submitted-by text come from the official index (updated 22.10.2026) and the 38 list pages as captured on 2026-10-23. The index presents the lists as approved by the CEC plenum on 27.9.2026. כחול לבן (כן) is not running: every candidate resigned (list page updated 21.10.2026). The capture parsed names mechanically from a PDF print of each page; 36 name strings it changed (14 truncated, 10 punctuation/spacing/geresh, 12 spelling) keep the 2026-09-19 HTML transcript text until each is checked against the page; see docs/CANDIDATE_REFRESH_2026-10-24.md. Submitted-by text is null for the 12 lists where the capture reflowed its punctuation. Party annotations were not captured and are null. Family/given names are not split. The approval and the withdrawal rest on that capture; gov.il could not be re-opened when this file was assembled.
